RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is weak evidence on its own. Clinical laboratory science and hospital management are female-majority fields in most countries, so a four-woman panel can easily arise by chance or from who holds the relevant senior posts. Raising it would read as an accusation built on nothing and would undercut your credibility on the point that actually has traction.

That point is the unanswered request. Two weeks of silence on a written explanation is a real procedural failure — press it, in writing, with a deadline, copying HR.

Also note: for a leadership post, a panel can legitimately rank documented management experience above a PhD. That may simply be what happened.
